W.note: Restrained line-art products, one blue accent, a sticky bag bar with total and checkout, and labeled steppers and feedback notes; the pantry grid is dense and clean on both viewports.

X.note: Solid cart drawer with shipping, tax and free-shipping hint, but the initials placeholder tiles, pill chips, native select and tall cards with descriptions read as generic template, and the mobile header stacks awkwardly.

Y.note: Stock states (sold out, only N left) and a full cart drawer are well handled, but emoji product art and badges add clutter and look dated, and on mobile the Cart button sits above the search field.

Z.note: Consistent line-art and a compact, minimal bag panel are good, but the primary Add to bag label wraps and clips inside its button on the desktop layout, a visible defect on the main action.
